---
title: "Helper Functions"
format: html
---

Use helper pages only when they support the operator across multiple workflow
pages.

Good uses for a helper page include:

- installation notes for a required tool;
- reusable shell commands the operator will run more than once;
- links to credentials, API setup, or institutional documentation;
- small helper functions that simplify repeated page logic.

If a helper page is not necessary, delete it. A Quarto Manual should stay as
small as the procedure allows.

## Replace This With Real Content

For example, a real helper page might explain:

- how to request cluster access;
- how to create an API token;
- how to verify that `quarto`, `python`, `R`, or `apptainer` are available;
- how to import helper code emitted by `quarto-emit`.
